chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a determined opening call: marching drums, then the lead strikes a rising climbing figure twice, a step higher each time, over a wind swell, landing on a held E chord}
positive_styles: high pulse-wave lead climbing in stepwise terraces
steady ascending arpeggio like footsteps on stone
white-noise wind swell cresting every four bars
mountain climbing route theme, determined and airy, sunset thinning to cold blue

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the climbing melody: a rising leap that overshoots, then a stepwise settle, the phrase then re-launched a step higher; hummable and determined, footstep arpeggio under it}
positive_styles: high pulse-wave lead climbing in stepwise terraces
steady ascending arpeggio like footsteps on stone
white-noise wind swell cresting every four bars
mountain climbing route theme, determined and airy, sunset thinning to cold blue

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Higher]
{the theme sequenced one step higher, brighter and fuller, a bell counter-line glinting, the wind swell cresting at each switchback}
positive_styles: high pulse-wave lead climbing in stepwise terraces

mountain climbing route theme, determined and airy, sunset thinning to cold blue

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{contrast: a breath on a ledge, F sharp minor and D major, longer notes looking out over the drop, the drums thinning to hat and kick, then a snare roll building back up}

chunks.text:
[Main Theme Return]
{the climb resumes at full stride, the theme at its brightest; the last bar steps down to the E dominant and voice-leads straight back up into the theme, no ending}
